```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab14", title = "Final review")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "A fair pipeline order is:",
  q2 = "Australian beer is quarterly, so m equals:",
  q3 = "The combined difference (1-B)(1-B^4) y_t equals:",
  q4 = "In three short sentences, which model would you ship for Beer and why?"
)
```

## What you will do

One-page decision card for the Beer bake-off.

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `fpp3`, `learnr`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Plot, transform?, d/D, orders, residuals, hold-out vs a naive baseline", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Fit the largest ARIMA first, then plot"),
  answer("Compare AICc across ETS and ARIMA, then stop"),
  answer("Difference twice, always"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("4", correct = TRUE),
  answer("12"),
  answer("7"),
  answer("1"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("y_t - y_{t-1} - y_{t-4} + y_{t-5}", correct = TRUE),
  answer("y_t - y_{t-1}"),
  answer("y_t - 2 y_{t-1} + y_{t-2}"),
  answer("y_t + y_{t-4}"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Baseline, one competitor, residual or hold-out evidence.",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Answer the questions above first, type your name, download the `.txt`, and upload it.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
